summary: @servicetitan/document-title preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a tempdir, chmods +x, and invokes execFileSync('bun', [math_init.js]) against a sibling file. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte obfuscated Bun-cjs bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs', shuffled string/opcode table, rotator function of the WV8StW form) unrelated to the package's advertised React document.title helper. The malicious loader (setup.mjs) and payload (math_init.js) are smuggled into the tarball outside the declared files allowlist (package.json files: ['dist','src']), while dist/index.js remains a benign React helper — installing the package runs the obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime on every `npm install`, delivering install-time remote code execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
